canonicalContracts.continuous: 09:00..11:29 and 12:30..15:24 start minute, inclusive; 11:30 auction 690 separate, 15:25..15:29 preclose no execution, 15:30 auction 930
canonicalContracts.entryPath: entry-owned bar at frozen entry minute through continuous and exact 930; lunch omitted in active count
canonicalContracts.execution: no order/fill; exact next scheduled OPEN is future replay only
canonicalContracts.opening: 09:00 and 12:30 first continuous bars, no separately recorded opening-auction row in this substrate
canonicalContracts.terminal: single-price exact 930 auction; missing remains UNKNOWN; 690 morning auction separate and excluded by frozen anatomy precommit

parser.barIntegrity: 7 finite numerical fields, positive OHLC, Low<=Open/Close<=High; duplicate timestamp rejects complete-path mask
parser.entryJoin: (arm, session|symbol|minute) frozen identity plus opportunityId lookup; IM/R1 worlds not pooled
parser.floatHandling: accept finite int-equivalent 540.0→540; reject 540.5, bool, string, NaN/inf/null, out-of-session timestamp; no rounding
parser.missing: absent scheduled bars UNKNOWN, no trade/halt/data-missing classification unproven

producer.nanInfNull: producer valid() filters nonfinite prices and compact raises on duplicate source Time; archive may still require empirical validation
producer.schema: today is list of 7-number bars [minute,O,H,L,C,Vo,Va] from np.array(...,float).tolist()
producer.timestampOrigin: raw Time HH:MM converted by minute_time to h*60+m; float ndarray preserves exact integral minute
producer.timezone: source Time is Japan cash market local clock; session date associated separately; numeric minute has no timezone token
